name: royal-blush
description: Royal Blush - a premium Indian wedding invitation platform with a complete admin suite.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @royal-blush/api" "npm run dev -w @royal-blush/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @royal-blush/api && npm run build -w @royal-blush/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @royal-blush/api && npm run typecheck -w @royal-blush/web
